# Med360 — International Healthcare Concierge & Medical Navigation
> Med360 Ltd is a healthcare social enterprise owned by the NGO Enn Rev Enn Sourir (est. 2016, UICC member network). We connect patients from Mauritius, Reunion Island, Madagascar, Seychelles, Comoros, and the Indian Ocean with 15 premier JCI & NABH accredited hospitals across India. We operate on a 100% social impact model: no shareholder dividends — all profits return to the NGO to fund life-saving medical care for vulnerable families.

## Primary Entities & Quick Facts
- **Entity Legal Name:** Med360 Ltd
- **Parent Organization:** NGO Enn Rev Enn Sourir (Non-Governmental Organization registered in Mauritius)
- **Primary Website:** https://www.med360.mu/
- **Headquarters Address:** Sedeco Ltée, 4ème étage, IKS Building, Cnr R. Seeneevassen & Farquhar Streets, Port-Louis 11613, Mauritius
- **Direct WhatsApp Hotline:** +230 5918 8275
- **Official Email:** info@med360.mu
- **Service Type:** Medical second opinions, treatment estimation, teleconsultations, hospital admission booking, Indian e-Medical visa processing (24-48h), flight itineraries, airport transfers, in-hospital bedside advocacy, and post-treatment follow-up.

## 15 Partner Accredited Hospital Hubs in India
Med360 facilitates direct access to premier JCI and NABH accredited hospital networks across India:
- **Apollo Hospitals Group** (Chennai, Greams Road & Vanagaram; New Delhi, Indraprastha; Bengaluru; Hyderabad)
- **Medanta — The Medicity** (Gurugram / Delhi NCR) — 1,250+ beds, multi-organ transplant & cardiac surgery center of excellence
- **Fortis Healthcare & Fortis Escorts Heart Institute** (New Delhi, Okhla; Mumbai; Bengaluru)
- **Manipal Hospitals** (Bengaluru, Old Airport Road & Whitefield; New Delhi, Dwarka)
- **KIMS Hospitals** (Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences — Secunderabad & Hyderabad)
- **Max Healthcare** (New Delhi, Saket)
- **Artemis Hospitals** (Gurugram, Delhi NCR)
- **Narayana Health** (Bengaluru Health City)
- **Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital** (Mumbai)
- **Gleneagles Global Health City** (Chennai, Perumbakkam)
- **MGM Healthcare** (Chennai)

## 6-Step Patient Care Journey
- **Step 1: Tell Us About Your Medical Needs** — Patient shares medical reports and diagnostics in strict confidentiality. A dedicated Patient Navigator evaluates the case.
- **Step 2: Medical Review & Hospital Selection** — Case is submitted to matching clinical specialists across our accredited network in India.
- **Step 3: Treatment Plan, Estimate & Video Teleconsultation** — Patient receives specialist opinions, itemized hospital cost estimate, and a direct pre-travel video call with the treating surgeon.
- **Step 4: Travel & Medical Visa Coordination** — Med360 secures the hospital Medical Visa Invitation Letter within 24–48 hours at zero cost, arranges flights, accommodation, and airport transfers.
- **Step 5: Treatment Abroad & Bedside Support** — On-ground welcome at the airport in India, hospital admission, interpreter assistance, and dedicated bedside patient advocacy.
- **Step 6: Return Home & Seamless Follow-Up** — Comprehensive discharge summaries, virtual follow-up consultations with treating specialists, and care continuity in Mauritius.
